articles.author: MANGOCEUTICALS, INC.
articles.headline: Mangoceuticals Announces Business Combination Agreement with Nuclea Energy Inc. to Advance Next-Generation Nuclear Microreactor Technology
articles.summary: Mangoceuticals announced an agreement with Nuclea for a proposed nuclear-technology business combination. Required shareholder and Nasdaq approvals and development milestones remained; it was not a completed commercial microreactor deployment.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original GlobeNewswire July 30 07:00 Eastern and Nasdaq explicit 7:00 am EDT.

articles.author: Nuclea Energy Inc.
articles.headline: Nuclea Energy Enters Definitive Business Combination Agreement with Mangoceuticals, Establishing a Path to a Nasdaq Public Listing to Advance the Morpheus Microreactor
articles.summary: Nuclea separately published its announcement of the proposed combination with Mangoceuticals. It concerns the same merger event, with its own later publication time and conditions; commercial and regulatory development of the reactor remained prospective.
articles.timestampEvidence: Full Newsfile syndication on Nasdaq explicitly July 30 10:35 am EDT; separately published counterparty release, not duplicate of 07:00 issuer release.
